Method of Attack: Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attacks targeting public-facing infrastructure such as websites of critical infrastructure organizations including airports and government websites
Impacted Systems: Websites of major U.S. airports (Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL), Los Angeles International Airport (LAX), Chicago O'Hare International Airport (ORD))
U.S. government websites in Colorado, Kentucky, and Mississippi
CISA's Protected Critical Infrastructure Information Management System website
Indicators of Compromise: Claims of attacks by KillNet on airport and government websites
Temporary offline status of some U.S. government websites
